rules.patrolNote: Gather rhyflers equal to or less than the agreed points total. Force Allowance (the number in brackets) applies at 300 points or less, stays the same up to 599, and doubles at 600 or more. Battles over 600 points are not recommended. (Core Rules pg 4, 10)

Support.text: May perform Supporting Fire when it meets the Task's requirements. Only Supports, and is Supported by, rhyflers with this ability.
pluck: Supporting Fire: costs 1 Pluck for each supporting rhyfler (Full Book p26)

Leader.text: Leader (X/Y): may perform a Leadership Task (e.g. Group Move, Fire and Advance) that includes X rhyflers within Y inches.
pluck: Group Movement: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p29)
Fire and Advance: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p28)

Melee.text: Melee (±X): modifies the Target Number of Melee Combat Tasks by X.

Ranged.text: Ranged (±X): modifies the Target Number of Ranged Combat Tasks by X.

Inspiring Presence.text: At the start of a Round, spend an Activation for one bonus up to its Level. L1: rhyflers within 3" get a free Steady Task. L2: rhyflers within 5" get +1 MA until your next Round. L3: rhyflers within 3" get +1 Sk until your next Round.

Medic.text: +1 to Tend Wounded rolls. A Cook with Medic may Tend Wounded on all rhyflers within 2" with one Task.

Musician.text: Musician (X): Rallying Song Task. A Ready Musician Recovers every friendly Gobsmacked rhyfler within X, changing them to Ready.

Standard.text: Rhyflers within 4" of the standard bearer double the Pluck they gain from taking enemies OOA or completing objectives. If the bearer goes OOA the standard may be picked up; if the enemy captures it, its commander gives them 3 Pluck.

PykPyk.text: PykPyk (X): X squirrel tokens kept off the table. At any point in your Round, spend one to reveal the current Activation card, reroll all dice on a Skill Check, or Tend Wounded an OOA rhyfler. Not an Activation or Task.

Killing Strike.text: May reduce the Target Number of its melee Skill Check by 2 to increase its Might result by 2.

Infiltrate.text: May start off the battlefield. When Activated, performs the Infiltrate Task: choose an Entry Point at least 4" from enemies and roll on the Infiltrate chart. Cannot be reacted to with Snapshot or Overwatch.

Dead-eye.text: May perform the Aimed Shot Task: a Ranged Attack that ignores Range Band modifiers. Only rhyflers with Dead-eye can use Aimed Shot.
pluck: Aimed Shot: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p30)

Blunt Round.text: After a Prepare Weapon Task, its shots against tractors have a 1d6+2 Might roll. No bonus against rhyflers.

Spotter.text: Assigned to a specialist with the same profile name when building the Patrol. When that specialist makes a Combat Skill Check it may reroll the highest die; this uses the Spotter's Combat Task for the Round.

Cadier.text: Mount. Has Thunderous Hooves and Skittish. A cadier hit by the 2-5/2-5 result on the Fragmentation Grenade chart is Rattled instead of going Prone.
pluck: Cavalry Charge: costs 1 Pluck, and its Powerful Blow is free (Full Book p46)
Mount or dismount: costs 1 Pluck instead of 1" of movement (Full Book p43)
Dismounting while Rattled: may also spend 1 Pluck to remove Rattled (Profiles p57 FAQ)

Thunderous Hooves.text: A rhyfler Charged by this unit may Skedaddle as a reaction to the Melee attack (resolved like a ranged reaction).

Skittish.text: A Rattled cadier cannot Charge. If a Charging cadier is Rattled by a Snapshot from its target, it continues but its Melee Attack is at -2.

Pole-arm.text: Within 2" of an enemy, may choose to become Engaged (and Engage them). Enemies without Pole-arm must be, or move to, within 1" to make Melee Attacks against it.
pluck: Enemies without Pole-arm: stepping within 1" to attack it costs 1 Pluck (or a Standard Move) (Profiles p6)

Automatic.text: Automatic (X): may perform Area Fire. Place a Medium template; each target in it chooses to Skedaddle or Return Fire, then roll to hit each one separately with an extra -X. Reduces Obstructing Cover by 1 (Light ignored, Normal becomes -1). If the firer is wounded by Return Fire, finish the remaining attacks before marking it OOA. Not usable as a Reaction.
Automatic.src: Profiles p8 (errata to Full Book p36)

Loader.text: If the firer is in base contact with its designated Loader (a basic squad rhyfler for squad weapons), +1 to the Skill Check.

Select Fire.text: Select Fire (X): attack up to X different enemies within a Medium template, each at an extra penalty equal to the weapon's Snapshot value. Or fire normally at one target with no penalty.

Blast.text: Blast (Size, Might): affects every model under a Small, Medium or Large template with the listed Might roll.

Slow Reload.text: Must spend an Activation to reload after a Ranged attack, or be marked unloaded and unable to fire.

Precision Fire.text: May target a specific Location on an Armored vehicle at an extra -2 to the Skill Check.

Carriage.text: Can perform the Move Weapon Task without breaking down. Leaving its emplacement loses any Dug In! bonus for the battle.

Gun Shield.text: Gun Shield (X): gives the crew an Obstructing Cover modifier of X.

HMG.text: Heavy machinegun Gunner Tasks: Standard Fire (Large template, attack any number inside) and Covering Fire (45° Fire Zone, attacks from inside roll on the Covering Fire chart). Gathers Heat markers; roll the Heat chart at 4.

Transport.text: Transport (X): carries up to X friendly rhyflers as Passengers.

Open Topped.text: Crew see 360°. Up to half the Transport capacity may fire from on board (with a movement penalty). Passengers can be targeted (vehicle counts as Obstructing cover) and are hit by Blasts.

Agile.text: May turn 45° at both the beginning and end of a Standard Movement Task (not after Gun It!).

Scouting Vehicle.text: No movement penalties for difficult terrain (still cannot enter Impassable terrain).

Turretless.text: No turret. Once per Round the Gunner may pass its Activation so the Driver immediately performs a Turn Vehicle Task.

Front Facing.text: Weapon fires from the vehicle's front arc.

Rear Facing.text: Weapon fires from the vehicle's rear arc.

Large Caliber.text: Reduces Obstructing Cover modifiers by 1 (Light ignored, Normal becomes -1), including on Return Fire, Snapshot and Overwatch. Against an Armored Vehicle: roll to hit on the standard Ranged Combat Result chart; on a hit roll the location, then a 1d6+2 Might roll on the Might v. AV chart. A Skill Check roll of 3 triples the Might; 4 or 5 doubles it.
Large Caliber.src: Full Book p37; Profiles p8 (errata to Full Book p54)
pluck: Choose the location hit on an Armored Vehicle: costs 1 Pluck, or take -2 to the Skill Check (Full Book p54)

Shotgun.text: No Range penalties. 1st Range Band: target only, +1 Skill. 2nd: target plus 1 more rhyfler within 1". 3rd: target plus up to 2 more within 2", each at -2. Cannot fire beyond 3 Range Bands. Extra targets may only Skedaddle.

Wallop.text: May perform a Powerful Blow for free.
pluck: Powerful Blow: costs no Pluck (normally costs 1) (Full Book p27, p35)
A Charge still costs 1 Pluck (Profiles p58 FAQ)

Skirmisher.text: No movement penalties from difficult terrain, and always counts as having a -1 Obscuring Cover modifier against ranged attacks (stacks with Prone).

Scout.text: Scout (X/Y): may perform Group Movement as if it had Leader, ignoring difficult terrain. Scouting Party: before the first Round, move itself and X rhyflers within Y up to full MA, ending in Cover or Prone.
pluck: Group Movement: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p29, p33)
Scouting Party: costs 1 Pluck, before the first Round (Full Book p33)

Communications.text: After the opposing commander draws the Activation card, the active commander may reveal its value.
pluck: Reveal the Activation card: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p30)

Lumbering.text: Ignores difficult terrain penalties and may cross Light or Normal Obstructing terrain up to half its height, destroying it. Cannot Gun It!

Turret.text: The vehicle's turret can rotate toward a target; the Gunner performs the Turn Turret Task.

Anti-Tractor.text: Smooth Bore Main Guns with this Trait add an extra 1d6 to Might Rolls against Armored Vehicles (not standard vehicles or rhyflers).

Bicycle.text: Adds 2 to Movement Allowance when moving in a straight line. Cannot cross Difficult Terrain. Uses the Bicycle Damage Chart.
pluck: Mount or dismount: costs 1 Pluck instead of 1" of movement (Full Book p43; Profiles p55)
Dismounting while Rattled: may also spend 1 Pluck to remove Rattled (Profiles p57 FAQ)

Braced.text: When fired, -1 to Skill unless the firer is Prone or in base contact with terrain providing cover. This penalty also applies to Return Fire, Snapshot and Overwatch.

Heavy.text: Heavy (X,Y): if X rhyflers are adjacent to the Heavy object it may be moved Y inches with a Standard Movement Task (one Activation, but counts as one Task for each rhyfler). Rhyflers moving it cannot Sprint.

Grafaenk Lance.text: Throw Lance (Prime Explosive) Task: declare a target tractor (never soft targets), make a 3" Move straight toward it ending within 6", and roll on the Grafaenk Mk4 Lance chart. The run gives -2 cover against Snapshot and Overwatch. If hit by an Interruption, read one row lower. A successful hit on a tractor throws shrapnyl: rhyflers within 2" suffer a 1d6+2 Might attack.

Hardened.text: May ignore the need to go Prone or become Gobsmacked when it Skedaddles.

AT Grenades.text: When assaulting an Armored Vehicle, gains a +2 shift on the Assaulting Vehicles chart and its Might becomes 2d6+1 for the attack.

Leap.text: Leap (X): when jumping during a Movement Task, multiplies the distance allowed (horizontal and vertical) by X, letting it clear some barricades, obstacles and enemy rhyflers.

Pack.text: Pack (X): for one Activation, X of these creatures may each perform a Task independently (moving or attacking). Each is still limited to two Tasks per Round.

Multi-Attack.text: Multi-Attack (X): may make X attacks per Ranged Combat Task, each against a different target, all declared first and resolved separately (including Reactions), each at an extra -X to Skill. If wounded by Return Fire, remaining attacks still resolve.

Onslaught.text: When performing Fire and Advance, this Leader may ignore the X limit on how many rhyflers join (they must still be within Y inches). Those moving may perform the Charge Task.
pluck: Fire and Advance: costs 1 Pluck (Full Book p28)
Each moving rhyfler may Charge: costs 1 Pluck each (Full Book p32)

Parry.text: When Gobsmacked by a melee attack, may make a Skill Check to avoid the change in Status. If the check fails, it goes Out of Action instead.

Tune Up.text: Tune Up (X): X times per battle. When the opponent rolls on a Standard Vehicle or Rattleped Damage chart, may make them roll two dice and take the lowest. Against Armored Vehicles, may raise the AV of the location hit by one before the Might roll.

Rattleped.text: Mechanical mount (mounted rhyfler rules). No movement penalties for difficult terrain (still not Impassable). Unlike cavalry, cannot make a Ranged Attack while Sprinting. An unmounted rattleped gives -2 Obstructing cover to a rider behind it. Uses the Rattleped Damage Chart.
pluck: Mount or dismount: costs 1 Pluck instead of 1" of movement (Full Book p43)
Dismounting while Rattled: may also spend 1 Pluck to remove Rattled (Profiles p57 FAQ)

Bolt Action.text: Has Slow Reload. May perform the Crack Shot Task instead of a standard Ranged Attack: no Range Band modifiers for that attack.

Indirect Fire.text: Indirect Fire (Prepare Weapon) Task: ignores Cover when setting the Blast Point but always -1. On a failed check the opposing commander sets the scatter (3+d3" in their chosen direction). May target a unit out of Line of Sight at a further -2 (total -3). Cannot target rhyflers in roofed, enclosed spaces.

Closed Hull.text: No top hatch: always counts as Buttoned Up, so the Crew Commander is limited by that status when Spotting.

Anti-tractor Grenades.text: When assaulting an Armored Vehicle, gains a +2 shift on the Assaulting Vehicles chart and its Might becomes 2d6+1 for the attack.
Anti-tractor Grenades.src: Profiles p26 (rule printed on the Fidwog page)

Steady Under Fire.text: May perform Supporting Fire for free. Only Supports, and is Supported by, rhyflers with Steady Under Fire.
pluck: Supporting Fire: costs no Pluck (normally costs 1 per supporting rhyfler) (Full Book p26, p33)

Bombardier.text: Does not need to Prime Explosive before the Throw Grenade Task; may go straight to the attack.

Scattergun.text: Fires normally but not beyond one Range Band. May also Volley Fire (Prepared): attacks every rhyfler, friend or foe, in a 1"-wide line from the firer to the final target (one Range Band). Roll on the Scattergun Outcome table before rolling to hit. Can only be reacted to by Diving for Cover.

Brutal Attack.text: When making a Powerful Blow, does not gain the Skill increase; instead adds +2 to its Might for the attack.
pluck: Powerful Blow: costs 1 Pluck, unless the rhyfler has Wallop (Full Book p27, p35)

Veteran.text: Performing the Recover Task does not count towards its two allowed Tasks that Round (it still costs an Activation).

HSG.text: Heavy shotgun Gunner Task, Standard Burst: place a Fire Lane cone in front of the weapon (Small template up to 3" away, then Medium, then Large, in a straight line). Rhyflers under it are attacked individually and may only Skedaddle. Also used for Overwatch. May load Solid Slugs (Full Book p71).

Élan.text: Rhyflers within this Leader's command range gain the Veteran ability.

Hunting Wysp.text: Declare a target rhyfler within 12" and roll on the Hunting Wysps chart. Results range from a Medium-template 1d6-1 Blast, to the target fleeing Gobsmacked, to the wysps leaving for the rest of the battle.

Trapper.text: During deployment, place 5 numbered trap markers per Trapper anywhere except the enemy deployment zone, at least 6" apart. Secretly record 2 as decoys and 3 as any mix of Alarm, Snap or Tractor Traps. A trap is revealed when an enemy unit moves within 2" and resolved by type.

Creature.text: Uses natural weapons such as claws or teeth. May only use the equipment on its profile, and has no grenades.

Taste for Squirrel.text: When a commander uses a Pykpyk, roll 1d6 for each unit with this ability on the field. On a 5-6 the Pykpyk is eaten and spent for no effect.

The Gloam has Eyes.text: Rhyflers within this Yawdryl's command range gain the Skirmisher ability.

Trench Armor.text: Halves the Might Roll of Fragmentation grenade attacks against it, and always passes Take Cover tests against Blast attacks.

Tractor Slugs.text: After a Prepare Weapon Task to load slugs, targets with an Armor Value hit suffer a Might Roll by range: 2d6 in the first Range Band, 1d6+2 in the second, 1d6 in the third. Still cannot fire beyond three Range Bands.

Saddle-born.text: Ignores the Snapshot penalty when firing during a Standard or Sprint Movement Task. Firing during a Sprint still has the -2 penalty for the mount's speed.

Cautious.text: Gains Ranged (+1) when positioned behind Obstructing Cover.

Pack Leader.text: Pack Leader (X): removes the Force Allowance limit on the selected Pack Creatures. On Their Scent Task: Group Move itself and up to X Pack Creatures regardless of distance, as one Activation.
pluck: On Their Scent: costs 1 Pluck, as it is a Group Move (Profiles p47; Full Book p29)

Retinue.text: Retinue (X): may bring up to X rhyflers with the Staff ability. Their own Force Allowance still applies.

Staff.text: May only be selected for a Patrol as part of another rhyfler's Retinue.

Smoke Pot.text: Thrown up to one Range Band, using the normal Blast rules for placement. The template stays until your next Active Round and counts as a Smoke Grenade template (Obscuring cover -1).

Hunting Party.text: Works like a heavy weapon team, but each member (Spotter, Scribe, Lackey and the Noblebuck) may perform only one Task a Round, and the party only one Combat Task in total. Uses its own bespoke Tasks to switch between its three weapons and boost attacks.
pluck: “Bring me Old Byss!” (Scribe): costs 1 Pluck (Profiles p48)
“Keep them coming!!” (Spotter): costs 1 Pluck (Profiles p48)

Casganarwyn.text: After deploying, roll a d3 to set its Inspiring Presence level (re-roll by spending an Activation). A rhyfler that uses one of its bonuses must then roll on the In Their Cups! chart.

Switch Ammo.text: Accompanies a specialist whose weapon lists two Blast values. The first is the default; the Loader switches to the second with a Prepare Weapon Task, every time the second value is wanted.

Thrown Weapon.text: May be thrown once per battle at an enemy within three Range Bands. If the target is Gobsmacked or taken OOA, the thrower may move to it and spend an Activation to recover the weapon and throw it again later.

AP Shell.text: The Splagen B.e's first (default) Blast value.

AT Shell.text: The Splagen B.e's second Blast value. A Loader with Switch Ammo must perform a Prepare Weapon Task each time to use it.

Green.text: While within the Leadership range (Y) of a rhyfler with Leader, gains Ranged (+1) and +1 to Skill on Take Cover checks.

Burly.text: Ignores the penalty from the Braced equipment trait, and counts as two rhyflers when moving objects with the Heavy trait.

Home Army.text: Has the Medic ability as if a Cook. If taken, her commander adds two Event Cards to the Activation Deck; she only activates on an Event Card, then may take up to two Tasks: Sprint to the nearest Gobsmacked or OOA rhyfler (either side), or Tend Wounded / Recover a nearby non-Ready rhyfler. If she is Gobsmacked or taken OOA, roll on the They Shot Mum! chart.

Like This!!.text: Once per battle, after a Militia Rhyfler within its Leadership range fails a Ranged Attack Skill Check, may make an immediate Crack Shot at that enemy (needs Line of Sight). Does not count as its only Combat Task that Round.
pluck: Crack Shot: costs 1 or more Pluck, with a bonus equal to the Pluck spent (Profiles p54)

Resilient.text: May perform the Tend Wounded Task on itself.

Flying Dismount.text: At the end of a mounted Movement Task, replace the bicycle with a Dismounted Rider and make a second Standard Movement Task (not ending Engaged), then roll on the Flying Dismount chart. Read one row lower if the first move was a Sprint.

factions.tagline: Stalwart Guardians of the Great Wall
factions.intro: Steeped in rich martial tradition and dedicated to preserving traditional Quar society, the Crymuster is the first military force to check the advance of the Crusader juggernaut, albeit at a terrible price. Every other nation on Alwyd has been conquered, partitioned, or otherwise subjected to the rule of another throughout history, but never Coftyr.

factions.tagline: The Stubborn and Patriotic Trench Watch
factions.intro: The main fighting force of Creevin is the Trench Watch. Their numbers are dwindling but those that remain are hardened veterans, held back only by the weight of the forces arrayed against them, and their increasing lack of supply.

factions.tagline: Liberators Who Will End the Long War
factions.intro: The Crusade is an ideological and political movement with the premise that The Long War is the inevitable result of the stratifications of Quar society. Quar culture is strongly clan and class-based, and for most of the history of the Quar ruling clans and their allied families have held the bulk of political power.

factions.intro: Fidwog, in Alwyd’s East, has successfully resisted being conquered by the Crusade. Because of Fidwog’s difficult geography and fierce resistance to the Crusade’s message, Alykinder chose to focus most of the military operations to the west of Alwyd.

factions.tagline: Hard-striking Quar of the Iron Houses
factions.intro: Descending from the merchant clans of the Nodd Ffae, the Foskyldae are known for their enormous Iron Houses that carry them across Alwyd as sharp-eyed merchants, shrewd intelligence agents, brave soldiers, and firmly self-reliant quar.

factions.intro: Within Coftyr proper are a handful of Principalities. Ostensibly free and independent countries of their own, each of these Principalities—and the regents that rule them—recognize Coftyr as their sovereign, pay taxes to the Crown, and enjoy the King’s protection. Foremost among these is the Principality of Gwynt.

changelog.title: First release
changelog.intro: All 12 factions from the Faction Profiles 10/26.

changes.text: Shaedyn: Blast (Small, 2d6). The book prints "Slow"; corrected to Small as confirmed by the game's designer.
Harlech Carbine: Sn -2. The cavalry weapon table prints -3 (Profiles p32); -2 confirmed by the game's designer.
Cavalry Yawdryl and Cavalry Scout Yawdryl: Leader (2/4). The book prints "Leader (2,4)".
Cavalry Dragoon Yawdryl (dismounted): Leader (2/4). The book prints "Leader (2,4)".
Caerten: the "one per 300 points" limit applies, although the row is missing its footnote marker.
The LMG limit footnote applies to the LMG Milwer. The book prints the marker on the SMG Milwer row.
"Blunt Rounds" corrected to Blunt Round to match the rule's name.
